coverage_notes: M.1–M.7 and M.10 contain notice, communications, amendment, assignment/delegation, severability, interpretation, governing-law, and force-majeure provisions. These are not permissions or restrictions on an activity in the supplied vocabulary; no Use clause is inferred from them.

The export prohibition in M.8 has no exact matching activity in the supplied vocabulary. The immutable anchor represents the distinct restriction on providing access to the Services; export itself remains unmatched.

paragraph_audit.reason: The paragraph includes an anchored restriction on providing service access, but its export prohibition and its notice, electronic-communications, amendment, assignment/delegation, and other procedural or contractual duties do not fit the fixed activity vocabulary. The general amendment provision does not itself impose a distinct activity condition that can be faithfully modeled as Use.
